title: OntoRAG embedding record
description: One line of an embeddings/vectors/*.jsonl file. Joined to a chunk by `id`. Vector dimensionality, provider and metric are declared once in embeddings/config.json and the manifest.

id.description: Chunk id this vector belongs to (== chunk.id).

vector.description: The embedding. Length MUST equal manifest.embeddings.dim. Stored as JSON numbers; values are L2-normalized when manifest.embeddings.normalized is true.
